Subject: Annual deposit schedule for committed spend (Q3 trigger)

Hi Avery / Lauren,

Quick note from finance at Acme — we're consolidating our vendor prepayments for this fiscal year and need the deposit trigger schedule for our committed spend with Redwood. Our procurement team will only release the first tranche once we have: 1) a clear date-based trigger schedule, 2) ledger instructions showing the accounting GL and invoice remittance, and 3) VAT handling guidance for cross-border invoices.

Can you send over a one-page schedule and the invoice remit details? We aim to wire the initial deposit the week of Aug 24th if everything looks good.

Attachments: none from our side yet — will expect your invoice/statement.

Thanks,
Oliver Grant
Director, Strategic Finance

Subject: Re: Annual deposit schedule for committed spend (Q3 trigger)

Oliver —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a simple trigger calendar (deposit_triggers_v1.xlsx) and a short PDF with ledger / remit instructions (ledger_instructions_v1.pdf). Highlights: 

- Schedule: three scheduled draws over FY27: 2026-08-31 (initial), 2027-02-28 (mid-year), 2027-08-31 (annual true-up). Each draw aligns to committed spend bands on the SOW.
- Invoice cadence: we will issue a single invoice per draw with the deposit amount and reference ACME deal ID (ACME-2026-ENT-09).
- Remit/GL: Payable to Redwood Inference, remit to the USD operating account (instructions in PDF). Please include your PO# in the invoice to speed AP processing.
- VAT: For US entity invoices to Acme US (billing@acme-corp.com) we will not apply VAT. If any draw is routed to a non-US entity, our policy is to include a taxable VAT line and we will provide country-specific VAT breakdowns at invoice time.

I've included Marcus for the accounting entries confirmation and Lauren for legal/PO follow-up.

Attachment: deposit_triggers_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Attachment: ledger_instructions_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Avery Johnson
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Avery. Two small items from our side to confirm before you route wires to the account listed in the PDF: 

1) VAT routing — please confirm the billing entity and country that Acme will use for the PO so we can mark invoices correctly (US vs UK/EU). If you plan to have a single centralized billing entity in the UK, we'll need to add VAT lines and provide a VAT breakdown for each draw.

2) PO and remit email — can you confirm which email AP will monitor for invoice processing? We prefer billing@acme-corp.com but sometimes invoices need to go to ap-invoices@acme-corp.com.

Operational ask: once you confirm, we'll issue the initial invoice dated 2026-08-31 and set the wire window to net-7 from invoice receipt. If you need net-30 we can adjust but that may move the wire date into September.
